scope: Bilingual machine translation chapter after T5 and before GPT-1. Covers aligned data, conditional loss, search, back-translation, multilingual conditioning and translation evaluation. No new practice route.

sources.sections: Jurafsky & Martin, SLP Chapter 13; existing Bookvar Transformer, T5 and evaluation chapters
sources.verification: Same source-conditioned autoregressive factorization, shifted target and masked access. Keep the fixed start symbol in the toy separate from T5's decoder start ID.

sources.sections: Heffernan et al., LASER3 §3 and Fig. 1
sources.verification: Distinguish teacher and student inputs, source of each target, cosine training and monolingual MLM. The encoder is used to mine bitext.

sources.sections: Sennrich et al. §3.2; Edunov et al. §5.1 and Fig. 1; Johnson et al. §§2 and 4; NLLB Nature 2024
sources.verification: Correct reverse direction and synthetic source. Check plot axes and that generation methods apply to synthetic training data rather than the evaluation decoder. Target-language signal and per-direction multilingual coverage.

sources.sections: Post 2018; Rei et al. §2.3 and Fig. 1; Freitag et al. §3
sources.verification: Clipped BLEU counts, brevity penalty, source-conditioned reference-based COMET estimator, and human category/severity; avoid claiming a score for an actual checkpoint in the illustrative example.
